name: loop-designer
description: dz AUTHORS, GATES and READS loops — it never RUNS one. Author agent loops as typed loop-plan/1 plans: four patterns, eight invariants INV-1..8, a layer-1 script gate and a run reader. A Codex session can author, validate, render and lint a loop over its shell; it cannot execute one — the rendered script runs only under the Claude Code Workflow runtime.
